CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: Overall milestone status formula for the record.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName, "Closed Lost") ), "Complete", "Open" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Overall status of the milestones on this deal.
CustomField.label: Milestone Status
